title: Work items know the kb facts they rest on
goal: Every story and task names the knowledge it needs as kb lookup questions and stable references (topic, QK answer, source id, fact key); research that the kb lacks is scheduled before the work that needs it; agents start from the packs of that knowledge instead of rediscovering it.
notes: Order: the knowledge field (ST-ireqmpda), then the measurement with a compact brief (ST-zptutwlf). The brief command (ST-u7bliqzx), research scheduling (ST-wgymzw72) and the planning skills (ST-hzja7lj4) wait on the measurement's blocking gates. Planning writes knowledge needs (asks and refs); only research and the kb's own skills write facts.
